id: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (2007)

facts.text: Make yourself at home, Harry. Molly's stew is on, so grab a bowl before Kreacher starts muttering.
facts.why: Not in the film. Sirius's real lines at headquarters are about the Black family tree, the original Order photo and missing James.
facts.fix: Make yourself at home, Harry. I can't stand this house, but Molly's cooking makes up for it.

fix_note.text: Make yourself at home, Harry. I can't stand this house, but Molly's cooking makes up for it.
